notes.Rate limit the arena: A player in a fight reads it every second and a half (40 a minute) and the base reads the lobby every 4 seconds, so 600 a minute leaves room for a dozen players behind one address. The arena's reads are cached for a second at the edge, so a flood that gets through mostly hits the cache, not the table.
notes.Rate limit the order book: A player's browser fetches a snapshot of Strike's order book when it connects to a fight's market, and again only if its live stream breaks, so 60 a minute per address is plenty and keeps a flood off Strike.

rules.description: Per address: the arena's routes, so a flood is turned away before it reaches a function or DynamoDB.
rules.name: Rate limit the arena

rules.description: Per address: the order book snapshot route, so a flood is turned away before it reaches a function or Strike.
rules.name: Rate limit the order book
